Footer.answer_1: Betalarab یک کازینوی آنلاین ارزهای دیجیتال و پلتفرم شرط‌بندی ورزشی است که طیف گسترده‌ای از بازی‌های کازینو و بازارهای ورزشی را به بازیکنان در سراسر جهان ارائه می‌دهد.
Footer.answer_2: بله، Betalarab تحت مجوز بازی رسمی فعالیت می‌کند و استانداردهای نظارتی را برای اطمینان از بازی عادلانه، امنیت و شفافیت برای کاربران خود دنبال می‌کند.
Footer.question_3: آیا شرط‌بندی در Betalarab ایمن است؟
Footer.answer_3: بله، شرط‌بندی در Betalarab ایمن است. این پلتفرم از اقدامات امنیتی پیشرفته، از جمله رمزگذاری و فناوری بازی عادلانه قابل اثبات، برای محافظت از داده‌های کاربر و اطمینان از نتایج عادلانه استفاده می‌کند.
Footer.question_4: با چه ارزهایی می‌توانم شرط ببندم؟
Footer.answer_4: Betalarab از چندین ارز دیجیتال پشتیبانی می‌کند، از جمله Bitcoin، Ethereum، Litecoin، Dogecoin و چندین ارز دیجیتال دیگر. برخی مناطق ممکن است گزینه‌های ارز فیات را نیز پشتیبانی کنند.
Footer.question_5: چه نوع بازی‌های کازینویی می‌توانم انجام دهم؟
Footer.answer_5: Betalarab انواع مختلفی از بازی‌های کازینو مانند اسلات‌ها، بازی‌های میزی، بازی‌های اصلی Betalarab و بازی‌های دیلر زنده از ارائه‌دهندگان پیشرو بازی ارائه می‌دهد.

AboutUs.title: درباره betalarab؟
AboutUs.content: betalarab یک پلتفرم مدرن شرط‌بندی و بازی کازینوی آنلاین است که در سال 2023 ایجاد شده و تجربه بازی نزدیک‌تری ارائه می‌دهد که شرط‌بندی با ارزهای دیجیتال یا ویزا و کارت‌های اصلی را سرگرم‌کننده‌تر می‌کند. با سبکی متمرکز بر جامعه ایجاد شده، betalarab به عنوان پلتفرمی که افراد با همان اشتیاق بازی را به هم متصل می‌کند، متمایز می‌شود. betalarab هدف دارد بهترین خدمات را در این زمینه ارائه دهد و محیطی امن و تجربه بازی مسئولانه نسبت به مشتریان ایجاد کند.
AboutUs.fast_games_explanation: با پلتفرم بهینه‌شده ما که برای سرعت و عملکرد طراحی شده است، تجربه بازی سریع را تجربه کنید.
AboutUs.casino_games_explanation: از طیف گسترده‌ای از بازی‌های کازینو از جمله اسلات‌ها، بازی‌های میزی و گزینه‌های دیلر زنده لذت ببرید.
AboutUs.sports_betting_explanation: با شانس‌های رقابتی و گزینه‌های شرط‌بندی زنده روی ورزش‌های مورد علاقه خود شرط ببندید.

FAQ.title: سؤالات متداول
FAQ.question_1: چگونه می‌توانم در betalarab ثبت‌نام کنم؟
FAQ.answer_1: تنها کاری که باید انجام دهید این است که روی دکمه ثبت‌نام کلیک کنید و آدرس ایمیل و رمز عبور مورد نظر خود را وارد کنید. همین. از شما اطلاعات شخصی اضافی خواسته نمی‌شود و شما داخل هستید!
FAQ.question_2: رمز عبور خود را فراموش کرده‌ام، چگونه می‌توانم حساب کاربری خود را بازیابی کنم؟
FAQ.answer_2: از منوی بالا روی ورود کلیک کنید و سپس روی فراموشی رمز عبور کلیک کنید. آدرس ایمیل خود را که در هنگام ثبت‌نام استفاده کرده‌اید تایپ کنید و رمز عبور جدید ارسال خواهد شد.
FAQ.question_3: چند حساب می‌توانم در betalarab ایجاد کنم؟
FAQ.answer_3: فقط یک حساب برای هر شخص، آدرس ایمیل، آدرس IP، شماره کیف پول رمزنگاری و یک دستگاه الکترونیکی. می‌توانید به دلیل ایجاد حساب‌های اضافی مسدود شوید و وجوه موجود در حساب می‌تواند مصادره شود.
FAQ.question_4: آیا می‌توانم هنگام استراحت (خود-محرومیت) حساب دیگری باز کنم؟
FAQ.answer_4: betalarab متعهد به بازی مسئولانه است و به بازیکنان خود اجازه نمی‌دهد حساب‌های متعدد باز کنند، به ویژه به دلایل خود-محرومیت. ما هدف داریم که به مشتریان خود محیطی امن و محافظت‌شده ارائه دهیم که تجربه‌ای خوشایند و پاداش‌دهنده به شما می‌دهد. ما مشتریان خود را تشویق می‌کنیم که از خدمات ما به صورت مسئولانه و معقول استفاده کنند.
FAQ.question_5: آیا محدودیت سنی در betalarab وجود دارد؟
FAQ.answer_5: برای ثبت‌نام در betalarab باید حداقل 18 سال سن داشته باشید، مشروط بر اینکه این حداقل سن مورد نیاز برای بازی آنلاین در حوزه قضایی شما باشد. اگر بالاتر است، باید الزامات حوزه قضایی محلی خود را برآورده کنید.
FAQ.question_6: What Sports Can I Bet On?
FAQ.answer_6: You can bet on a wide range of sports including football, basketball, tennis, cricket, esports, MMA, boxing, and many other popular international sports.
FAQ.question_7: How Do I Watch Live Streams?
FAQ.answer_7: Live streams are available directly on the Betalarab platform for selected sports events. Simply navigate to the sports section, choose an event with live streaming enabled, and watch in real time.

HelpCenter.Title: Help Center
HelpCenter.Subtitle: Support and answers for
HelpCenter.HeroDescription: Browse common topics below or search for a specific question. If you still need help, contact support.
HelpCenter.TopicsDescription: Pick a category to narrow down answers.
HelpCenter.StillNeedHelpDesc: Our team can assist with account issues, transactions, and promotions. Please don't share your password.
HelpCenter.EmailDesc: Best for documents and detailed requests.
HelpCenter.SecurityNoteDesc: Enable 2FA and contact support immediately if you suspect account compromise.
HelpCenter.category_getting_started_description: Account setup, verification, and first deposit.
HelpCenter.category_payments_description: Deposits, withdrawals, fees, and processing times.
HelpCenter.category_bonuses_description: Bonus eligibility, wagering, and common rules.
HelpCenter.article_create_account_title: How do I create an account?
HelpCenter.article_create_account_body: To create an account on {brand}, select "Sign Up", enter your details, and confirm your email. For security, choose a strong password and enable 2FA if available.
HelpCenter.article_kyc_body: Verification helps protect you and prevents fraud. You may be asked for proof of identity and address before withdrawals are processed.
HelpCenter.article_responsible_gaming_body: You can set deposit limits, cooling-off periods, or self-exclusion in your account settings. If you feel gaming is no longer fun, please use these tools or contact support.
HelpCenter.article_deposit_methods_body: Supported methods vary by region. In the cashier, you'll see the options available to you, along with any minimum/maximum deposit limits.
HelpCenter.article_withdrawal_times_body: Withdrawal times depend on verification status and payment method. After approval, processing can range from minutes to several business days.
HelpCenter.article_chargebacks_title: What is a chargeback and why is it important?
HelpCenter.article_chargebacks_body: A chargeback is a payment reversal initiated by your bank or card provider. Excessive chargebacks can lead to restrictions. Please contact support first if you need help with a transaction.
HelpCenter.article_wagering_body: Wagering requirements indicate how many times a bonus must be played through before it becomes withdrawable. Check the promotion terms for the exact multiplier and eligible games.
HelpCenter.article_bonus_issues_title: My bonus didn't activate—what should I do?
HelpCenter.article_bonus_issues_body: First, ensure you opted-in and met the minimum deposit requirement. If everything looks correct, contact support with your transaction ID and the promotion name.
HelpCenter.article_promo_terms_title: Where can I find promotion terms?
HelpCenter.article_promo_terms_body: Promotion terms are shown in the Promotions section and may also appear in the cashier during deposit. We recommend reviewing terms before opting in.
HelpCenter.article_2fa_body: Go to Account → Security → 2FA, then follow the steps to pair your authenticator app. Store backup codes safely.
HelpCenter.article_locked_account_body: Accounts may lock after multiple failed login attempts. Use "Forgot Password" or contact support to regain access. Never share your password with anyone.
HelpCenter.article_privacy_body: We use your data to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, and prevent fraud. For details, review the Privacy Policy linked in the footer of the site.

SelfExclusion.Title: Self-Exclusion
SelfExclusion.Subtitle: Block access to your account on
SelfExclusion.TakeABreakDesc: Self-exclusion blocks access to your account for a fixed time. It's a strong step if gambling feels out of control.
SelfExclusion.Bullet1: You won't be able to log in or place bets during the exclusion period.
SelfExclusion.Bullet2: Promotional messages may stop (where supported), but receipts/required notices may still be sent.
SelfExclusion.Bullet3: In many regions, self-exclusion can't be undone until the period ends.
SelfExclusion.ChoosePeriodDesc: Pick the option that gives you real breathing room.
SelfExclusion.Period7dDesc: A short reset to stop impulsive play.
SelfExclusion.Period30dDesc: Good if you need a stronger break.
SelfExclusion.Period6mDesc: A longer option to rebuild habits.
SelfExclusion.Period1yDesc: A serious, long-term step for protection.
SelfExclusion.AccessBlockedText: You cannot log in, deposit, or play while the self-exclusion is active.
SelfExclusion.WithdrawalsText: You may still be able to withdraw available funds, depending on rules in your region.
SelfExclusion.MarketingReducedText: We'll stop promotions where supported, but important account notices may still be sent.
SelfExclusion.SupportAvailableText: If you're unsure, contact support or a professional helpline for guidance.
SelfExclusion.IfYouFeelUnsafeText: If you're in immediate danger or feel you might harm yourself, contact local emergency services right away.
SelfExclusion.Confirm1: I understand I will not be able to gamble during this period.
SelfExclusion.Confirm2: I understand self-exclusion may not be reversible until it ends.
SelfExclusion.Confirm3: I want to proceed for my wellbeing.

LawEnforcement.Title: Law Enforcement Requests
LawEnforcement.Subtitle: Data request guidelines for
LawEnforcement.RequestingDesc: We take user privacy seriously. We disclose user information only in response to valid legal process or where permitted by law for emergency situations.
LawEnforcement.BeSpecificText: Include identifiers, date ranges, and exact data categories.
LawEnforcement.UseOfficialChannelsText: Send from an agency email whenever possible.
LawEnforcement.EmergencyHelpText: Clearly mark emergencies and provide justification.
LawEnforcement.OverviewBody: This page explains how law enforcement and authorized government agencies can request user data from {brand}. We review each request for validity and scope, and we disclose information only when legally required.
LawEnforcement.WhereToSendBody: Send requests from an official government or agency email address whenever possible. If you must send by another method, include clear contact details so we can verify authenticity.
LawEnforcement.WhereToSendBullet1: Email: legal@betalarab.com (replace with your legal inbox)
LawEnforcement.WhereToSendBullet2: Emergency: emergency@betalarab.com (replace with your emergency inbox)
LawEnforcement.WhereToSendBullet3: Mail: [Company Legal Address] (replace with your address)
LawEnforcement.WhatToIncludeBody: To help us process quickly, include the following information:
LawEnforcement.WhatToIncludeBullet1: Agency name, case number, and requestor contact details
LawEnforcement.WhatToIncludeBullet2: Legal process type (e.g., subpoena/court order/search warrant) and issuing jurisdiction
LawEnforcement.WhatToIncludeBullet3: Identifiers (username, account ID, email, phone, transaction IDs, wallet addresses, IPs, timestamps)
LawEnforcement.WhatToIncludeBullet4: Date range and specific data categories requested
LawEnforcement.WhatToIncludeBullet5: Preferred response format and any deadline stated by the legal process
LawEnforcement.TypesOfDataTitle: Types of data we may have
LawEnforcement.TypesOfDataBody: Availability varies by service use and retention policy. Examples may include:
LawEnforcement.TypesOfDataBullet1: Basic account information (profile details, verification status)
LawEnforcement.TypesOfDataBullet2: Login and security logs (IP addresses, device/session metadata)
LawEnforcement.TypesOfDataBullet3: Payment and transaction records (deposits, withdrawals, chargebacks)
LawEnforcement.TypesOfDataBullet4: Gameplay activity (timestamps, game/provider identifiers, results metadata)
LawEnforcement.EmergencyRequestsBody: If you believe there is an imminent threat to life or serious physical harm, mark your request as an emergency and include details supporting the emergency. We may disclose limited information when permitted by law.
LawEnforcement.EmergencyRequestsBullet1: Describe the emergency and why it is time-sensitive
LawEnforcement.EmergencyRequestsBullet2: Provide identifying information and any relevant timestamps
LawEnforcement.EmergencyRequestsBullet3: Include a callback number for verification
LawEnforcement.InternationalRequestsBody: Requests outside our operating jurisdiction may require additional legal process (e.g., MLAT/letters rogatory) or local legal validation. We will respond according to applicable laws.
LawEnforcement.ResponseProcessBody: We verify the requesting authority, review legal sufficiency, limit disclosures to what is required, and may push back on overly broad requests.
LawEnforcement.ResponseProcessBullet1: Verification of requestor identity and authority
LawEnforcement.ResponseProcessBullet2: Legal review for validity, jurisdiction, and scope
LawEnforcement.ResponseProcessBullet3: Production of responsive records (if any) in a secure manner
LawEnforcement.ResponseProcessBullet4: Notice to users where required or permitted (exceptions may apply)
LawEnforcement.PreservationRequestsBody: We can preserve certain records for a limited period when we receive a valid preservation request. Preservation does not mean production.
LawEnforcement.PreservationRequestsBullet2: Include legal basis for preservation and the preservation period requested
LawEnforcement.PreservationRequestsBullet3: Follow up with formal legal process for production
LawEnforcement.CostFormatTimingBody: We aim to respond promptly. Timing depends on request completeness, scope, and legal review. We may provide records electronically and securely. Fees may apply where permitted by law.
LawEnforcement.ImportantNotesBody: This page is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. {brand} will interpret and apply this process consistent with applicable laws.
LawEnforcement.ImportantNotesBullet1: Do not send sensitive data about minors unless specifically required and lawful
LawEnforcement.ImportantNotesBullet3: We do not provide access or "live monitoring" of user accounts
LawEnforcement.DisclaimerBody: This page is general information and does not replace legal advice. Processes and requirements may vary by jurisdiction. Replace placeholder contact details (emails/address) with your real legal contacts.

GamblingHelpline.Title: Gambling Helplines
GamblingHelpline.Subtitle: Confidential help for
GamblingHelpline.NeedHelpDesc: You're not alone. Free, confidential support is available. If you feel out of control, please contact a helpline below or talk to someone you trust.
GamblingHelpline.EmergencyText: If you are in immediate danger or feel unsafe, contact local emergency services right now.
GamblingHelpline.HelplinesByRegionDesc: Choose a service in your country/region. Links below go to external websites.
GamblingHelpline.Step1Text: Take a break. Close the game. Breathe.
GamblingHelpline.Step2Text: Call or chat with a helpline (confidential).
GamblingHelpline.Step3Text: Use limits or self-exclusion in your account.
GamblingHelpline.Tip: Tip: If you're worried about your spending, consider setting a deposit limit today.

ResponsibleGambling.Title: Responsible Gambling
ResponsibleGambling.Subtitle: Safer play tools and support for
ResponsibleGambling.PlayForFunTitle: Play for fun. Stay in control.
ResponsibleGambling.PlayForFunDesc: Gambling should be entertainment—not a way to make money or cope with stress. {brand} offers tools to help you set limits, take breaks, and get support when you need it.
ResponsibleGambling.ImportantNoteDesc: If you feel at risk of harm, consider starting a cooling-off period or self-exclusion and contacting professional support.
ResponsibleGambling.SetLimitsText: Control spending and time with deposit, loss, and session limits.
ResponsibleGambling.TakeBreaksText: Use cooling-off or self-exclusion when you need space.
ResponsibleGambling.GetSupportText: Access resources for confidential help anytime.
ResponsibleGambling.SaferPlayToolsDesc: These controls can be offered in your account settings. Some availability depends on your region.
ResponsibleGambling.DepositLimitsDesc: Set a cap on how much you can deposit over a given period.
ResponsibleGambling.DepositLimitsPoint3: Changes may take effect after a cooling-off period (policy-dependent)
ResponsibleGambling.LossLimitsDesc: Limit how much you can lose within a time window.
ResponsibleGambling.LossLimitsPoint1: Useful if you tend to chase losses
ResponsibleGambling.LossLimitsPoint3: Can be adjusted responsibly as needed
ResponsibleGambling.SessionTimerDesc: Get reminders to take breaks while playing.
ResponsibleGambling.SessionTimerPoint3: Helps you stay aware of play time
ResponsibleGambling.CoolingOffDesc: Take a short break from gambling for a fixed period.
ResponsibleGambling.SelfExclusionDesc: Block access for a longer period if you need stronger protection.
ResponsibleGambling.SelfExclusionPoint2: Prevents gambling during the exclusion window
ResponsibleGambling.SelfExclusionPoint3: Support team can help if you're unsure what to choose
ResponsibleGambling.RealityCheckDesc: Regular pop-ups showing time spent and net results.
ResponsibleGambling.QuickSelfCheckDesc: If you answer "yes" to any of these often, consider using limits or taking a break.
ResponsibleGambling.Check1: Do I gamble longer than I planned?
ResponsibleGambling.Check2: Do I chase losses to try to win back money?
ResponsibleGambling.Check3: Do I hide my gambling or feel guilty about it?
ResponsibleGambling.Check4: Has gambling affected my mood, sleep, work, or relationships?
ResponsibleGambling.Check5: Do I gamble with money I can't afford to lose?
ResponsibleGambling.Check6: Do I feel stressed or restless when I can't gamble?
ResponsibleGambling.FaqsDesc: Common questions about safer gambling and controls.
ResponsibleGambling.Faq1A: Responsible gambling means playing for entertainment, within affordable limits, and taking steps to prevent harm. It includes setting boundaries, taking breaks, and asking for help early if gambling stops feeling fun.
ResponsibleGambling.Faq2Q: How do I know if gambling is becoming a problem?
ResponsibleGambling.Faq2A: Warning signs can include chasing losses, hiding gambling, borrowing money to play, feeling anxious or irritable when not gambling, or spending more time/money than intended. If any of these sound familiar, consider using limits or taking a break and contacting support.
ResponsibleGambling.Faq3Q: Can I reverse a self-exclusion or cooling-off period?
ResponsibleGambling.Faq3A: In many jurisdictions, self-exclusion is not reversible until the period ends. Cooling-off may also be non-reversible once started. Exact rules depend on your region and operator policy—choose the option that best supports your wellbeing.
ResponsibleGambling.Faq4Q: Do limits guarantee I won't lose money?
ResponsibleGambling.Faq4A: No. Limits are tools to help you control time and spending, but gambling always involves risk. Only play with money you can afford to lose.
ResponsibleGambling.Faq5Q: What if I'm worried about someone else?
ResponsibleGambling.Faq5A: If you're concerned about a friend or family member, encourage them to take a break and seek professional help. You can also share support resources and suggest they enable limits or self-exclusion.
ResponsibleGambling.GetSupportDesc: If gambling is causing harm, reach out. Support is confidential. You can also contact {brand} support to activate limits or self-exclusion.
ResponsibleGambling.ContactSiteSupportDesc: Help with limits, account access, and safer play tools.
ResponsibleGambling.ProfessionalHelpDesc: Talk to a qualified counselor or local support service.
ResponsibleGambling.ConcernedAboutSomeoneDesc: Encourage them to pause and seek help. Share this page and resources.
ResponsibleGambling.UrgentSafetyText: If you're in immediate danger or feel unsafe, contact local emergency services right away.
